title: FR: DesertSync with 2 Masters/data sources
symptom: The user wants to use two devices (a smartwatch and a smartphone) to collect data via NFC and/or MiaoMiao, with the smartwatch normally acting as master and the smartphone taking over if the watch runs out of power. However, with two masters enabled, followers only follow one randomly, and one master doesn't get data because the MiaoMiao only allows one Bluetooth peer at a time.
cause: The thread suggests that the limitation is due to the device (e.g., MiaoMiao or Dexcom transmitter) only allowing one peer at a time, and that having two masters is not supported by the device, not an xDrip issue.
fix: No definitive fix is provided. Suggestions include using Nightscout follow instead of xDrip sync, and a comment notes that as of a few Nightly releases ago, treatments can be uploaded from both master and follower. The issue was closed as unclear.
evidence_quote: As far as having two masters, this seems to be possibly a limitation by the device. You cannot have more than one device collecting from a Dexcom transmitter both on the mobile slot. This is not an xDrip issue.
